full_judgment: Having considered the submission made by the learned counsel and having examined the papers and documents annexed along with the writ petition, we are of the opinion that the petitioners produced sufficient documents and proof along with this writ petition that they were employees of the abolished DESA therefore, under the provisions of ঢাকা বিদ্যুৎ বিতরণ কর্তৃপক্ষ(সংশোধন) অধ্যাদেশ; ২০০৮ section 2 sub-section 3 (gha) the petitioners are entitled to be absorbed into the DPDC Ltd. in accordance to the provisions of Surplus Public Servants Absorption Ordinance, 1985 (Ordinance No.34/85).
